bootstrap.unit: Independent128-index multinomial draws in(regime,reference)order; shared across SNR/method/fit within each of9 blocks. Newworldseeds domain-separate references, including path counts.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on frozen fits/policies/grid. Bonferroni4 only for two whole-grid contrasts acrossNMSE/BER; all other intervals pointwise descriptive.

interpretation: receiver always means the frozen A-selected proposal. If C fails, it is unconfirmed and the operational incumbent remains prior; test outcomes never change that choice.
scoring: Equal-cell mean dB ratio-of-sums; group means average metrics, not channels. Pooled linear is the arithmetic mean of fit-specific pooled error/energy ratios. Group p95/p99/max average corresponding fit-specific diagnostics, not an ensemble-channel distribution.
